```{r}
# Load data
# merged places comes from places.R script
# Used .rds to preserve geometry column. Saving as .csv removes the <sf> object functionality
data <- readRDS("D:\\rwjf_noise\\data\\prepped_data\\merged_lachs_2018.rds") 

# data %>%
#   pull(PHQ) %>%
#   table()

# Modify PHQ, Depression, Asthma, and General Health to set the Don't know and refused to NA
# otherwise they will form small groups that may pose problems for model sparsenes
data <- data %>%
  mutate(across(c(PHQ, ASTHMA, DEPNOW, HSGEN, HS2PH, HS3MH, HS4ALD), ~ ifelse(.x %in% c("Do not know", "Refused"), NA, .x)))

# Collapse Age group
data <- data %>%
  mutate(AGEGROUP_c = 
    case_match(
      AGEGROUP,
      c("18-24", "25-29", "30-39") ~ "18-39",
      c("40-49", "50-59") ~ "40-59",
      .default = "60+")
    )

# Set Refused to NA for GENDERO
data <- data %>%
  mutate(GENDERO = ifelse(GENDERO == "Refused", NA, GENDERO)) 

# Collapse race
data <- data %>%
  mutate(RACESOP_c = 
    case_match(
      RACESOP,
      c("AI/AN", "Do not know", "Multiracial/Other", "NHOPI", "Refused") ~ "Other/Unknown",
      .default = RACESOP)
    ) %>%
  mutate(RACESOP_c = factor(RACESOP_c, levels = c("White", "African American", "Asian", "Latino", "Other/Unknown")))

# Convert to numeric
data <- data %>%
  mutate(across(HS2PH:HS4ALD, ~ as.numeric(.x)))


```

# Unweighted Respondent characteristics
```{r}
data %>%
  mutate(has_geoid = ifelse(is.na(GEO_CT), 0, 1)) %>%
  select(
    AGEGROUP_c, RACESOP_c, GENDERO, FPL_FIN,
    PHQ, DEPNOW, ASTHMA, HSGEN, HS2PH, HS3MH, HS4ALD,
    has_geoid) %>%
  mutate(across(HS2PH:HS4ALD, ~ as.numeric(.x))) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    # by = has_geoid,
    statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})"),
    label = list(
    AGEGROUP_c ~ "Age",
    RACESOP_c ~ "Race", 
    GENDERO ~ "Gender",
    FPL_FIN ~ "Federal Poverty Line",
    PHQ ~ "Positive for PHQ2", 
    DEPNOW ~ "Current Depression", 
    ASTHMA ~ "Asthma", 
    HSGEN ~ "Self-reported General Health", 
    HS2PH ~ "Number of Poor Physical Health Days in the Past 30 Days", 
    HS3MH ~ "Number of Poor Mental Health Days in the Past 30 Days",

    has_geoid ~ "GEOID Available"
    )
  ) %>%
  bold_labels() #%>%
  # add_overall() %>%
  # add_p()
```

)

# Number of responses per tract (denominator = all unique geocoded tracts)
```{r}
data %>%
  drop_na(GEO_CT) %>%
  group_by(GEOID) %>%
  count() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(n) %>%
  mutate(n = factor(n)) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    label = list(n ~ "Number of responses per tract")
  )
```


# Frequencies & proportions of outcomes with geocoded data
```{r}
data %>%
  mutate(has_geoid = ifelse(is.na(GEO_CT), 0, 1)) %>%
  mutate(
    has_phq = ifelse(has_geoid == 1 & !is.na(PHQ), 1, 0),
    has_dep = ifelse(has_geoid == 1 & !DEPNOW %in% c("Do not know", "Refused"), 1, 0),
    has_asm= ifelse(has_geoid == 1 & !ASTHMA %in% c("Do not know", "Refused"), 1, 0),
    has_gen= ifelse(has_geoid == 1 & !HSGEN %in% c("Do not know", "Refused"), 1, 0),
    has_phd= ifelse(has_geoid == 1 & !HS2PH %in% c("Do not know", "Refused"), 1, 0),
    has_mhd= ifelse(has_geoid == 1 & !HS3MH %in% c("Do not know", "Refused"), 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(has_phq:has_mhd) %>%
  tbl_summary()
```


# PHQ2
```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(PHQ_num = case_match(
    PHQ,
    "Yes" ~ 1,
    "No" ~ 0,
    .default = NA)) %>%
  mutate(pw_exp_db_cen = pw_exp_db - mean(pw_exp_db, na.rm = TRUE))
```


## Collapse values within tracts
* Jun's recommendation
```{r}
data_collapsed <- data %>%
  group_by(GEOID) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_phq = mean(PHQ_num)
  )

data_collapsed <- data_collapsed %>%
  left_join(., data %>% select(GEOID, pw_exp_db_cen), by = "GEOID")

collapsed_tracts_model <- lm(mean_phq ~ pw_exp_db_cen, data = data_collapsed)

broom::tidy(collapsed_tracts_model)
```

## Unadjusted glm model


```{r}
# placed here to harmonize the variable used in the model, although it was originally create
# during mlm development
data <- data %>%
  mutate(pw_exp_db_cen = pw_exp_db - mean(pw_exp_db, na.rm = TRUE))

mod_phq_un_glm <- glm(PHQ_num ~ pw_exp_db_cen, family = "binomial", data = data)

summary(mod_phq_un_glm)
```

## Unadjusted glmer model
```{r}
# This model fails to converge and is nearly unidentifiable
# lme4::glmer(PHQ_num ~ pw_exp_db + (1 | GEOID), family = binomial(), data = data)

# Unscaled pw_exp_db resulted in very large eigenvlue model nearly 
# unidentifiable, rescaling to attempt to address the problem
data <- data %>%
  mutate(pw_exp_db10 = pw_exp_db / 10)

# Model fails to converge, but pw_exp_db10 addresses unidentifiable warning
# lme4::glmer(PHQ_num ~ pw_exp_db10 + (1 | GEOID), family = binomial(), data = data)

# Center the db values, using pw_exp_lin to calculate the centering results in errors
# when converting back to db since some values are negative before log10().
data <- data %>%
  mutate(pw_exp_db_cen = pw_exp_db - mean(pw_exp_db, na.rm = TRUE))

# Model converges
mod_phq_un_glmer <- lme4::glmer(PHQ_num ~ pw_exp_db_cen + (1 | GEOID), family = binomial(), data = data)

summary(mod_phq_un_glmer)
```

## 50:50 mixture likelihood ratio test
* Test if adding the random effect for tract improves model fit.
```{r}
# From Don Hedeker's MLM notes. Testing the random effect requires the 50:50 
# mixture approach
# Results in a significant p-value indicating the random effect improves fit
lrt <- 2 * (logLik(mod_phq_un_glmer) - logLik(mod_phq_un_glm))
p <- 0.5 * pchisq(lrt, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)

data.frame(
  LRT = round(as.numeric(lrt), 4),
  p = round(as.numeric(p), 4)) %>%
  format_gt_tbl()
```



## Unadjusted weighted model

```{r}
# Create the survey design object again, since there have been some 
# modifications to the class of some of the variables.
des <- svydesign(
    ids = ~1, # Sets sampling units or post stratification units
    weights = ~POP_WGT, # Sets populations weights
    data = data
)
```

```{r}
mod_phq_un_wt <- svyglm(
    PHQ_num ~ pw_exp_db_cen,
    design = des,
    family = quasibinomial()
)

summary(mod_phq_un_wt)
```

```{r}
# Comparing the parameter estimate for noise in the unweighted glm model vs the weighted glm model, suggests that the parameter estimates are similar. I get .009 for one and 0.01 for the other respectively, so these are very similar.
# Suggests that weighting isn't dramatically changing the estimated relationship between X and Y.
# We may be OK without weighting.
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false
# Model fails to converge with age only, collapsed levels
data <- data %>%
  mutate(AGEGROUP_c = 
    case_match(
      AGEGROUP,
      c("18-24", "25-29", "30-39") ~ "18-39",
      c("40-49", "50-59") ~ "40-59",
      .default = "60+")
    )

data %>%
  pull(AGEGROUP_c) %>%
  table(., useNA = "ifany")

# Model fails to converge with gender alone at 2 levels
data %>%
  pull(GENDERO) %>%
  table(., useNA = "ifany")

data <- data %>%
  mutate(GENDERO = ifelse(GENDERO == "Refused", NA, GENDERO))

# Model fails to converge with agegroup collapsed and gender 2 level only
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    pw_exp_10db_cen =
      (pw_exp_db - mean(pw_exp_db, na.rm = TRUE)) / 10
  )


```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false
tract_phq <- data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(PHQ),
    !is.na(pw_exp_db),
    !is.na(GENDERO),
    !is.na(GEOID)
  ) %>%
  group_by(GEOID) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    cases = sum(PHQ_num == 1),
    noncases = sum(PHQ_num == 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

tract_phq %>%
  summarise(
    n_tracts = n(),
    no_cases = sum(cases == 0),
    all_cases = sum(noncases == 0),
    mixed = sum(cases > 0 & noncases > 0)
  )
```
